realReviews.author: Lawton Segler
realReviews.text: Meticulous.   If it needs to be perfect, hire Luke Starnes. He’s a REAL carpenter, and a pleasure to work with. He installed this breadboard backsplash in our new kitchen. Each piece was fitted one at a time. No gaps. Absolutely perfect!

realReviews.author: Michelle Ubben
realReviews.text: Luke worked with us to cure the chronic mess in our garage by building a custom closet across the back and an open shelf unit. He worked with us on lumber options to keep the cost down. And he was reliable, quick, and a pleasure to work with. Highly recommend!

realReviews.author: Zach Melby
realReviews.text: I was really impressed with Luke’s craftsmanship and the pride he takes in his work. He helped us with a framing/trim project and I wouldn’t hesitate to call him again in the future. 10/10 would recommend Starnes Fine Carpentry!

finalCta.headline: Have a carpentry project in mind?
finalCta.body: Send a few photos and rough measurements or pick a time to talk it through. You'll get a written estimate before any work is booked.

faq.q: Do you take on small jobs?
faq.a: Yes. A single shelf, a bit of trim or a small repair is welcome. Send a photo and we'll let you know.

faq.q: Can you help keep the cost down?
faq.a: Yes. We'll go through lumber and material options with you so the project fits your budget.

faq.q: What kind of projects do you do?
faq.a: Trim and framing, kitchen backsplashes and carpentry, custom closets, shelving and other interior woodwork.
Ask when you request your estimate and we'll send the license and insurance details for your project.

faq.q: What happens after I submit a request?
faq.a: Your details come straight to us, you get a text and email confirmation, and we follow up to talk through the project.
